question:
Find out the correct antonym of the following word:

realize
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The word "**realize**" means to understand or become aware of something. The antonym of **"realize**" would be a word that means the opposite, which is "**misunderstand.**"
 
• To misunderstand is to fail to understand or interpret something correctly. This aligns with option 1, which states that the correct antonym of **"realize**" is **"misunderstand."**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Why the other options are incorrect:**

 
 
• **Understand:** This is a synonym of "**realize**," not an **antonym**. Both words mean to grasp the meaning, significance, or nature of something.

 
 
• I** understand** how you must feel.
 
 
 
• **Comprehend:** **Similar to "understand," **this is also a synonym of "realize." It means to grasp mentally or to understand something fully.
 
 
• I simply couldn't** comprehend** what had happened.
 
 
 
• **Grasp:** This is another **synonym of "realize.**" It means to seize and hold firmly or to understand something fully.
 
 
• he has a poor **grasp **of maths.
